description: Aantal klachten Fluvius is a dataset listed in Fluvius open data portal, an open data portal of a distribution network operator, published or maintained by Fluvius (Flanders). Binnen Fluvius definiëren we een klacht als een uiting van ontevredenheid van een externe partij over Fluvius, haar dienstverlening en/of producten. We grijpen elke melding aan als een opportuniteit om onze producten, onze dienstverlening of processen te optimaliseren. De klachten zijn opgesplitst in type klacht, terecht of onterecht en per product. Coverage: Belgium (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Marktwerking. Its keywords are Klachten. The portal shows 2026-04-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open data license - FLUVIUS (https://opendata.fluvius.be/p/licentieopendatafluvius). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fluvius-open-data-portal.
